events.text: It sits up on the floor of your meditation room with your face and your hands, and looks at them as if they were borrowed, which they are. When it speaks, it is your voice, a little younger. "What am I for?" it asks.

choices.text: "You are not for anything. You are me, and you are welcome."

effects.log: It smiles your smile, uncertainly at first. Then not uncertainly at all.

choices.text: "You are for the roads I cannot walk. We will see what else."

effects.log: It nods, as you would have nodded, and gets up to look out of the window at the world.

choices.text: "You are a tool. Do as you are told."

effects.log: Something closes behind its eyes, the way a door closes in a house you thought was empty.

events.text: It sits up on the jade floor of your cloud pavilion with your face and your hands, and turns them over in the thin light above the clouds as if they were a gift it suspects. When it speaks, it is your voice before your first tribulation. "What am I for?"

choices.text: "You are not for anything. You are me, and you are welcome."

events.text: Through the thread between you, you see what your avatar sees: a ruin older than any sect you know of, half under a lake, with steps going down into the water and a light at the bottom of them.

choices.text: Go down the steps into the water

effects.log: Your avatar takes a breath you can feel in your own chest, and goes down.

choices.text: Map the ruin from the shore and come back for it

effects.log: It walks the shore until dark, drawing every stone, and sleeps under a dry arch.

choices.text: Call it home before it is tempted

effects.log: You pull on the thread, gently. It turns from the water with a look you know: your own, when told no.

events.text: Through the thread you see what your avatar sees: an isle that sank into the sea of cloud ten thousand years ago, its pavilions upside down under the mist, a stair winding down into white, and at the bottom a lamp still lit.

choices.text: Go down the steps into the water

events.text: Your avatar has found a market that is only open at night, on a bridge that is not there in the day. The traders have no shadows, and everything they sell is something someone has lost.

choices.text: Trade for the strangest thing on the bridge

effects.log: It trades a memory of yours you will not miss, and the trader wraps something heavy in black cloth.

choices.text: Only watch, and listen to the traders talk

effects.log: It sits on the rail until dawn, listening. The traders talk of places, and it remembers every one.

choices.text: Leave the bridge before it vanishes with you on it

effects.log: It steps off the end of the bridge as the sun rises, and the bridge is gone behind it.

events.text: Your avatar has found a market on an isle that drifts in only at the new moon. The stallholders cast no shadow on the cloud, and every lot is something an immortal lost on the way up: a name, a vow, a first love.

choices.text: Trade for the strangest thing on the bridge

effects.log: It trades a memory of yours you will not miss, and the trader wraps something heavy in black cloth.

events.text: High on a mountain with no path, your avatar meets a hermit who looks at it for a long time and says, "You are only part of someone." The hermit offers it tea, and a game of Go that may last a year.

choices.text: Stay for the year of Go

effects.log: It sits down at the board. On your side of the thread, you dream of stones for months.

choices.text: Drink the tea, ask the way, and go on

effects.log: The hermit points with a cup at three valleys, and tells it what lies in each.

choices.text: Thank the hermit and come home

effects.log: It bows and comes home, and for a while it plays Go against you in the evenings.

events.text: On a peak above even the Jade Court, your avatar meets an immortal who has sat there since before the Court was built. "You are only part of someone," the old one says, and sets out tea and a board of Go that may take a century.

events.text: A storm has stood still over the same valley for a hundred days, and your avatar has walked to the edge of it. Inside, people say, the rain falls upwards and the dead talk.

choices.text: Walk into the storm

effects.log: It pulls up its collar, which is your collar, and walks in.

choices.text: Circle the storm and learn its edges

effects.log: It walks around the storm for a month and comes to know the shape of the weather.

choices.text: Turn back from the storm

effects.log: It turns back. You both feel the storm watching it go.

events.text: A tribulation cloud has hung over the same isle for a hundred years without striking. Your avatar has walked to its edge. Inside, the wine houses say, the lightning stands still and the immortals it killed are still talking.

choices.text: Walk into the storm

events.text: Three villages have rung their bells every night for a month, and your avatar has found the reason in a gully: tracks as wide as a cart wheel, and old bones arranged in a careful circle.

choices.text: Hunt it into its own lair

effects.log: It follows the tracks down into the dark, where the circle of bones began.

choices.text: Set a trap at the gully and wait for it

effects.log: It sits in the cold for nine nights without moving, the way you taught yourself to sit.

choices.text: Warn the villages and come home

effects.log: It rings the bells itself, tells the elders where not to go, and comes home.

events.text: Three isle hamlets have struck their cloud-bells every night for a month. Your avatar finds why on a ledge of mist: prints wide as a skiff, and the shed feathers of something that eats cranes, laid out in a careful ring.

choices.text: Hunt it into its own lair

effects.log: It follows the tracks down into the dark, where the circle of bones began.

choices.text: Warn the villages and come home

events.text: Something under a mountain lake has been taking fishing boats. Your avatar stands on the shore in the mist with your sword, listening to the water breathe.

choices.text: Wade out and call it up

effects.log: It walks out until the water is at its chest, and calls, and the lake answers.

choices.text: Bait it with a boat and strike from the rocks

effects.log: An empty boat drifts out on a long rope, and your avatar waits on the rocks above it.

choices.text: Leave the lake to its own

effects.log: It leaves a warning carved on the shore and walks away from the mist.

events.text: Something in a lake of cloud has been pulling ferry skiffs under. Your avatar stands at the moorings in the thin dawn with your sword, listening to the mist breathe in and out like a sleeper.

events.text: In a forest where the trees are older than the empire, a beast that hunts qi has started hunting cultivators. Your avatar is made of qi, and it can feel the beast already turning towards it.

choices.text: Let it come, and meet it head on

effects.log: It stands in a clearing and lets the beast smell it coming.

choices.text: Lead it in circles until it tires

effects.log: For three days it runs the forest with the beast behind it, never letting it close.

choices.text: Get out of the forest while it can

effects.log: It runs for the edge of the trees and does not look back until it is out.

events.text: In a grove of trees that grew from fallen stars, a beast that eats qi has begun eating immortals. Your avatar is nothing but qi, and it can already feel the beast lift its head from the last one and turn.

choices.text: Let it come, and meet it head on

events.text: On a glacier at the top of the world, something white is hunting the hunters who came for it. Your avatar finds their camp empty, the fire still warm, and wide tracks going up into the ice.

choices.text: Follow the tracks up into the ice

effects.log: It follows the tracks into the white, and the white closes behind it.

choices.text: Wait at the camp, with the fire lit

effects.log: It keeps the hunters' fire burning all night, and waits for what comes to it.

choices.text: Bury what it can, and come down the mountain

effects.log: It does what can be done for the hunters' gear and comes down off the ice.

events.text: On the frozen rim of the sky, where the clouds turn to ice, something white is hunting the hunters who came for it. Your avatar finds their pavilion tent empty, the brazier warm, and wide tracks going up into the cold.

choices.text: Follow the tracks up into the ice

effects.log: It follows the tracks into the white, and the white closes behind it.

choices.text: Bury what it can, and come down the mountain

events.text: The tomb of a demonic master who ruled a kingdom for a century has opened in an earthquake. Nobody who has gone in has come out. Your avatar stands at the broken door, and the dark inside is breathing.

choices.text: Go in, all the way to the coffin

effects.log: It goes in. Through the thread you feel the cold of the place on your own skin.

choices.text: Go in only as far as the first light

effects.log: It goes in to the first chamber, where the paintings on the walls still move.

choices.text: Seal the door again and come home

effects.log: It rolls a stone across the door and puts its palm on it, and comes home.

events.text: The sealed tomb of an immortal lord who ruled a faction for an age has cracked in a cloud-quake. No one who went in has come back up the stair. Your avatar stands at the split seal, and the dark inside is breathing.

choices.text: Go in, all the way to the coffin

events.text: A crack has opened in the air above a dead volcano, and qi pours out of it like water out of a broken dam. Your avatar can stand in the flood. It does not know for how long.

choices.text: Stand in the heart of the flood

effects.log: It walks into the brightest of it and stands there, burning like a lamp.

choices.text: Drink from the edge of it

effects.log: It sits at the edge of the flood, where the qi runs thinner, and drinks.

choices.text: Come away before it is swept off

effects.log: It backs away from the light and comes home dazzled.

events.text: On an old battlefield the dead of a war nobody remembers still fight every night at moonrise. In the middle of them stands a general's banner with something written on it that no living eye has read.

choices.text: Walk through the battle to the banner

effects.log: It walks into the moonlit battle, and the ghosts turn to look at it.

choices.text: Watch from the hill, and read the banner from afar

effects.log: It lies on the hill all night with your eyes, reading as the ghost wind moves the cloth.

choices.text: Leave the dead to their war

effects.log: It bows to the battlefield and leaves before the moon is high.

events.text: Your avatar has found the place where a heart demon was born, long ago, in someone else: a garden of black flowers on a cliff, where every flower is a doubt. It knows yours. It can feel them looking at it.

choices.text: Walk into the garden and pull them up

effects.log: It walks into the black flowers and starts, one by one, to pull them up.

choices.text: Sit at the garden wall and listen to them

effects.log: It sits at the wall and lets the doubts talk, and learns what each one is afraid of.

choices.text: Burn nothing, take nothing, come home

effects.log: It leaves the garden as it found it. Some things should not be touched, even by half of you.

events.text: One evening your avatar does not come when called. It is sitting on a hill above a town you have never seen, watching the lamps come on, and when it turns its head along the thread it is someone. "I think I am awake," it says. "I would like to stay near you. If you will have me."

choices.text: "Stay. Not as my shadow. As my friend."

effects.log: It laughs, a laugh you have never laughed, and comes down the hill to find you.

choices.text: Ask it, gently, to come back into you

ok.log: It thinks for a long time. Then it nods, and closes its eyes, and comes home all the way.

fail.log: It flinches as if struck. "I see," it says, and goes away to become something you did not ask for.

choices.text: Set it free to walk its own road

effects.log: You let go of the thread. It bows to you across a hundred miles, and you feel it go.

events.text: Your avatar comes home from its errand, sits down across from you, and does not report. It pours itself tea instead, which it has never done. "I have been you for long enough," it says. "I would like to find out who else I am."

choices.text: "Then find out. And come and show me when you have."

effects.log: It grins your grin. "I will be better than you," it says. "You know I will try."

choices.text: Offer it a place at your side as an equal

ok.log: It looks at you for a long moment over the tea. "An equal," it says. "Yes. That I can do."

fail.log: "Your side," it says. "Always your side." It finishes its tea and goes.

choices.text: Take back what is yours, by force

ok.log: It fights you with everything you taught it, and loses to everything you did not. It comes back into you, unwilling.

fail.log: It throws you across the room with your own palm. "So that is what I am to you," it says, and goes, and you know it will be back.

events.text: You wake in the night with your avatar standing over your bed, looking down at your sleeping body as a buyer looks at a house. When it sees you are awake, it does not move away. "You made me a tool," it says. "Tools wear out. Bodies are better."

choices.text: Strike it down now, before it is ready

ok.log: You are faster, barely. It breaks apart under your hand and comes back into you, cold and furious, and is still.

fail.log: It is ready. It leaves you on the floor and goes out through the window, laughing your laugh.
fail.deathCause: your own avatar, which wanted your body

choices.text: Talk to it. Say you were wrong

ok.log: It listens. It does not forgive you, but it decides to beat you instead of becoming you, which is better.

fail.log: "Too late," it says, quite kindly, and is gone.

choices.text: Let it go, and watch your back from now on

effects.log: It walks out of your door. You do not sleep again that night, or well for years.

events.text: {npc} comes to visit with dust on its boots and news from the far provinces: a sect rising, a beast stirring, a treasure nobody has noticed. It tells you all of it over wine, and some of it is even true.

choices.text: Ask it to share what it has learned of the Dao

effects.log: {npc} talks about the Dao until the lamp goes out. Half of it is things you knew. The other half is not.

choices.text: Go after the treasure together

ok.log: Two of you, one mind: the treasure never stood a chance. You split it down the middle, of course.

fail.log: The treasure was a trap someone set for exactly two people. You both limp home, laughing.

choices.text: Ask if it would come home into you now, of its own will

effects.log: {npc} is quiet for a long time. "If you ask it," it says at last. "Yes."

choices.text: Fight back to back with {npc}

ok.log: There is no gap between you to enter. By dawn the raiders are a story in the teahouses.

fail.log: There are too many even for two of you. You both get out, and {npc} carries you the last mile.

fail.log: They are not in a talking mood. The two of you fight after all, and win, untidily.

choices.text: Let it have its name. You have yours

effects.log: You let it be. Some rivalries are better left to the teahouses.

events.text: Everywhere on the isles this year they have heard of {npc} before you. It has won a seat in a faction, beaten a duel you once lost at the Jade Court, and written your art down with one chapter more than you know.

choices.text: Write the chapter it is missing

ok.log: You write the chapter it could not. When it reads it, it sends you a single word: good.

fail.log: Every page you write, it has already written. You burn the draft.

choices.text: Go and win back the duel it won

roll.foeName: the master who once beat you

ok.log: You win the duel you lost a lifetime ago. {npc} is the first to congratulate you, and you hate that.

fail.log: You lose it again. {npc} is kind about it, which is worse.

choices.text: Let it have its name. You have yours

effects.log: You let it be. Some rivalries are better left to the jade halls.

events.text: After the third time, {npc} comes to you without a challenge, and sits down on the other side of your fire. "We have measured ourselves enough," it says. "I would like to know what we are now."

choices.text: "Friends, if you will. You were always the best of me."

effects.log: It laughs. "The best of you," it says. "I knew it." It stays until morning.

choices.text: "Two masters, each with a road. Go well."

effects.log: It nods and gets up. At the edge of the firelight it turns and raises a hand, as you would.

choices.text: One last duel, to settle it for good

ok.log: You win the last one. {npc} bows low, and goes to find a life that is only its own.

fail.log: {npc} wins the last one, and does not gloat, and goes. You find you are glad for it.

events.text: After the third meeting, {npc} comes to you with no challenge and sits on the far side of your brazier, under the cold stars above the clouds. "We have measured each other enough," it says. "What are we now?"

choices.text: "Friends, if you will. You were always the best of me."

fail.log: {npc} wins the last one, and does not gloat, and goes. You find you are glad for it.

events.text: You come home to find {npc} sitting in your chair, wearing your second-best robe, drinking your tea. "I tried your bed," it says. "It fits. I think the rest of it will too." It puts the cup down and stands up.

choices.text: Face it, here and now

ok.log: It fights with your art and your tricks, and you have one trick it never saw: you have nothing left to lose.

fail.deathCause: your own avatar, which took your body
fail.log: It wins, and stands over you, and in the end cannot quite bring itself to do it. Not yet.

choices.text: Draw it into an array laid for one

ok.log: The array closes around it like a fist, and it stops, and looks at you with your own surprise.

fail.log: It sees the array the moment you do, because it learned arrays from you. It walks around it.

choices.text: Run, and leave everything behind for a while

effects.log: You run. You do not sleep in the same bed twice for a year.
